readings.title: Classification with Quantum Measurements
facts: Input-output density conditioning; mixed-state route yields a normalized overlap-kernel label mixture.
Known classifier, not a newly discovered quantum attention method.
limitations: PDF title Classification; official landing title Supervised Learning retained as alias. Original mismatch receipt preserved.
Eq15 and Eq17 have different printed normalization conventions; normalized mixture derived from Eq4/7/8.
Remaining pages and source experiments not reproduced.

readings.title: Unambiguous discrimination between linearly independent quantum states
facts: Unambiguous zero-error discrimination with positive success for every pure state requires linear independence.
limitations: Forty d8 class states fail that assumption; this does not prohibit noisy POVMs with40 outcomes.
Semantic no-relation is not an inconclusive physical outcome; no general classifier no-go.

readings.title: Quantum Computation and Decision Trees
readings.locators: SectionII PDFp5 Eq2.1 and p6 Eq2.8/2.12/2.13
facts: Known quantum evolution exp(-iHt) and Born transition probabilities distinguish it from exp(-Ht) Markov evolution.
limitations: Original graph is a real tree Laplacian, not the proposed cubic complex Gram graph.
No penetrability, speedup or semantic task theorem transferred; remainder not audited.

readings.title: Consistent Multiclass Algorithms for Complex Performance Measures
facts: General multiclass metrics can be written as functions of a confusion matrix; Table1 includes macro F1.
Under the explicit differentiability,monotonicity and distribution conditions, optimal classifiers relate to a loss matrix formed from the metric gradient at an optimal confusion matrix.
The stated efficient algorithm instantiations target concave or ratio-of-linear metrics; arbitrary macro F1 is not automatically certified by either shortcut.
transfer_limits: Read scope only pp1-4; algorithm proofs/experiments/supplement/code unread.
Our fixed positive39 excludes class0 and includes absent classes with zeroF1; do not substitute the paper full-n average or micro F1.
Current short repeated development data do not certify consistency,calibration or an independent optimum.

readings.title: Reversing quantum dynamics with near-optimal quantum and classical fidelity
readings.finding: Section V Eq37 defines the known square-root/pretty-good measurement. Q-RMEA token-frame whitening gives exactly this measurement for a regularized uniform token ensemble.
readings.limit: State-discrimination average fidelity guarantees do not automatically imply downstream semantic attention or classifier utility for an arbitrary learned query.
